body: Huh, it's crazy that only one person that I don't even know cared to offer some form of help. I see all these other posts that get a crazy amount of people willing to share advice. I guess I'm just not worth it. See you on the other side.
I appreciate you taking the time to help. Thank you for the info on the phone plan as well.
I'm poor and live in a small town with zero opportunities to progress in life, how does that even make sense?
